about_the_game:
"Swords and Hexes" a top-down strategy-RPG adventure!

Enter the wacky world, top-down, feet up, frolicking through the enchanted land. Tittle-tattle with its dwellers, explore, collect, upgrade, strategize and hex-and-slash your foes all while resisting the hero’s journey. 

You’re a scruffy servant  who’s gotten into a bit of a pickle while running errands for the dainty Prince Charles, for he is the one saviour who will crush the dark forces that loom (naturally).

Traversing through the picturesque land of Hexagonia, you'll cross paths with its many residents from the lake monster Bessy, to the Maiden Painter, and the Troll Brothers. Choose your allies wisely, or you may end up woven in a mess between industrious beavers and tree hugging squirrelies, and oh boy do we all know how that fable goes.

Move from hex to hex and trick or smash your foes, in a style of your choosing, through turn-based strategy with a plethora of options, like weapons, gemstones, scrolls, abilities, the environment itself, and an occasional sandwich.

With fun do-abouts like mining, fishing, hog riding (our favourite) you will be collecting shoddy and peculiar items for yourself and for the whole family. (Even grandma is enjoying herself!) So if you like returning pans to old ladies, or learning about wildlife, this one’s for you!
